name: The St. Regis Bal Harbour Resort
positioning: A 27-story oceanfront resort in Bal Harbour at the northern tip of Miami Beach, across Collins Avenue from the Bal Harbour Shops
best_for: Travelers who want a beachfront base across the street from the Bal Harbour Shops
Families and large groups who need a multi-bedroom suite
Guests interested in contemporary design and art

facts.text: The resort rises 27 stories over Collins Avenue and a white-sand beach.
Bal Harbour sits at the northern tip of Miami Beach.
The resort sits on nine acres of oceanfront property and was designed by Sieger Suarez Architectural Partnership.
The interiors are by Yabu Pushelberg and pay homage to Miami's Art Deco style.
All rooms have balconies with ocean views.
Marble bathrooms have walk-in dual-head rainforest showers and separate soaking tubs.
Atlantikos serves Mediterranean dishes in a blue-and-white setting reminiscent of Greece.
BH Prime is the resort's steakhouse, using locally sourced seasonal ingredients.
La Gourmandise serves the St. Regis Afternoon Tea, which requires a 24-hour advance reservation.
The Spa at St. Regis covers 14,000 square feet.
The resort's beach is 1,000 feet long.
The Family Traditions program offers activities and amenities for children.

highlights.text: A silver cloud sculpture by Inigo Manglano-Ovalle, Cloud Prototype No. 4, hangs from the ceiling at the arrival.
A champagne sabering ceremony is performed nightly at 6 pm at the St. Regis Bar.
The Oceanfront Day Villas are 600-square-foot air-conditioned villas with a private indoor lounge and a full bathroom and shower.
The eight-bedroom Grand Palace Suite on the 23rd floor is the largest suite at the resort.
The Bal Harbour Shops are directly across Collins Avenue from the hotel.

considerations.text: The minimum age to check in is 21.
The hotel does not provide airport shuttle service.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing that reflects the ultra-luxury positioning.
